item.description: Cory Doctorow on the Offline Podcast talking about enshittification HP Linux Imaging and Printing - currently wrestling getting my discontinued HP printer on Linux. 9Front released “Release” back in November I’ve been playing around with Graphene OS OpenBSD 7.8 has been released and it has Raspberry Pi support.
